== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Reserve Pilot (Japanese)|Reserve Pilot]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/tcg/company-sets/1997-decipher-star-wars-ccg-new-hope-limited-japanese/imagegallery/587873 Robert John's Japanese Hoth PSA showcase], [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/157709595/lwGviQnPCkes8aALzJE25w.jpg source photograph], PSA certificate 90960099.

Crop rectangle <code>(145, 620, 1290, 2220)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>96e090488fcf0f2b92316c97a67667ef89686a3b70ad34f25a58ff50bac35548</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
